pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   B. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   D. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   B. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Creation of Plants and Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Physical and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Story: Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. B — Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. B — Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Creation of Plants and Animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Physical; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bible Story: Holy Bible; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Bible; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
